def ij(s, W):      # 1D -> 2D

# Helper to render a belief vector (over N) into an (H,W) image, zeroing walls.
def belief_to_grid(b, maze):
    img = np.zeros((H,W), dtype=float)
    img[free_mask] = b[free_mask.reshape(-1)]
    return img
